absent: Exact numeric defaults for pause loop exiting gap window grow shrink ceiling and preemption multiplier.
Full layouts of control configuration capability per processor loaded state and enlightened structures.
Implementation of setup helpers for control configuration nesting preemption helpers and cache flush programming.
Complete locking protocol beyond named mutex spinlock and processor pinning.
Full nested entry exit and EPT violation resolution state machines.
Remaining MSR bitmap mode semantics and extended state interception policy.
Failure handling beyond logging for virtualization instruction errors.

findings.text: Host support is selected by a processor match table that requires the virtualization feature and ends with an empty sentinel entry.

Core virtualization features default to enabled with mostly read storage covering VPID and virtual NMI plus flexpriority plus EPT plus unrestricted guest plus EPT dirty tracking plus CET plus mode based execution plus nesting plus page logging plus enlightened VMCS plus fast EOI.

Strictness defaults emulate invalid guest state and fail on inconsistent control configuration while suppressing invalid dumps; pause loop exiting gap and window tuning plus grow shrink and ceiling use built in defaults.
Processor tracing defaults to system mode and last branch record capability lives in storage fixed after initialization.
MSR bitmap modes distinguish extended APIC handling where plain mode is one and accelerated virtual interrupt mode is two.
Maximum TSC multiplier is the full unsigned 64 bit maximum with every bit set.

Guest control register zero policy always clears cache disable and write through disable, always sets numeric error, and additionally always sets paging and protection except in unrestricted guest where only numeric error is forced.
Guest control register four policy always sets virtualization enable; protected mode also forces address extension; real mode also forces virtual 8086 mode and address extension.
Real mode guest owned flags are all bits except privilege level and virtual mode; trace status mask excludes filter context trigger error stopped and byte count indications.
Preemption timer scaling uses a mostly read multiplier and enable plus a maximum fixed after init; an alternate build forces the enable to false.

Entry cache flush control holds two branch keys for unconditional and conditional flushing, a mutex, a mostly read selector defaulting to automatic, a table from flush states to display names with parse eligibility, an order four sized allocation and a page buffer.

Flush option parsing accepts only eligible names and reports invalid argument otherwise; setting stores the choice before mitigation init else programs it under mutex unless the processor is unaffected; query prints the active mitigation name; a build without mitigations warns once on set and always reports never.
Updates to the entry cache flush selection outside early parsing hold a dedicated mutex across programming.
Read error trampoline runs without instrumentation and on hardware fault reports a spurious fault, otherwise briefly enters an instrumentable section to log the failing field.

Instruction failure handlers report field or address plus hardware error code for write clear load VPID invalidation and EPT invalidation; the currently loaded control structure is kept per processor.
Identifier management uses a dedicated spinlock; loaded control structures are linked on a per processor list.

Global control configuration and capability are immutable after init; a constant table maps code data stack extra FS GS task and descriptor segments to selector base limit and access fields; host interrupt table base is cached in a scalar.
Level two flush setup fails for lack of memory without a partition assist page, otherwise publishes the assist address and VM identity into the enlightened structure and enables nested flush control.
Preemption timer workaround list enumerates affected processor signatures covering listed server and client steppings.
Emergency virtualization disable on the calling processor clears every loaded primary control structure and any shadow.
Pause loop exiting window only changes through a bounded grow helper using global target grow and ceiling, setting dirty and emitting an update trace when the value moves.

Control selection pins the processor while installing and loading the target; level one load and restore helpers enforce expected loaded state when in guest mode and a scope guard automates the pair; emulation is demanded when invalid state emulation is enabled and guest state is invalid.

Instruction skip advances the guest pointer by the exit length with narrow truncation outside long mode, except misconfiguration under hypervisor re emulates as skip, zero length from enclave exits leaves the pointer unchanged, and interrupt shadow is always cleared.

Nested trap flag becomes pending only when allowed and no higher priority exception awaits besides debug, requesting event processing, otherwise it is cleared; the skip wrapper refreshes this state before advancing.
Supported feature control allows locked state plus virtualization inside and outside secure mode plus launch control plus enclave enable plus late machine check enable.

Feature register read serves the emulated virtualization range from nested configuration when nesting is on, reports handled without data when nesting is off, and marks all other identifiers unsupported.

Processor compatibility requires virtualization support and identical control configuration to the reference, dumping differing words on mismatch, and virtualization enable requires an assist page in enlightened mode before taking a reference.
Control register three exiting is the union of load and store exiting; extended state exit bitmap is zero so no component causes exits.
Real mode exception policy records exit length for breakpoints and defers to guest debugging for breakpoint and debug, reflects arithmetic and fault vectors to the guest, and ignores other vectors.
Real mode fault handling with zero error for protection or stack faults attempts emulation with halt propagation, otherwise queues the exception; machine checks report handled for the run loop.

Advancing a nonzero length instruction after enclave exit warns; misconfiguration length is undefined under some hypervisors and must not be trusted; intercepting page faults with EPT active warns unless small address allowance; enclave violations must be reflected never resolved.

Extended disable faults are recognized by nonzero disable state without timestamp disable; page fault path sends host async faults to common handling, reflects enclave faults by guest capability, fixes and reinjects EPT faults, and otherwise uses common fault handling.
Page fault fixup reuses the processor error when the fault is not present or the guest walk succeeds, then calls the registered injector to deliver the fault.
